verdict.rationale: Whether source code is available under an open license is a fair question for any software product, including a SaaS payroll service, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows QuickBooks Payroll publishing its source under an open license. The pack documents only proprietary APIs, SDKs and a sandbox company, which are developer building blocks and not open source.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
